title: compareFiles
body:
## compareFiles

Compare two HDF5 files object by object - presence, kinds, types, shapes, attributes, optional storage and numeric values within absolute and relative tolerances - as a regression check (h5diff semantics).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A value differs when |a-b| > absolute + relative*|reference|; NaN equals NaN.
- The native comparison must agree with an independent host comparison of the h5dump readings.

Native binding: `h5py.File(r) pairwise structure, attribute and value comparison with absolute/relative tolerance (h5diff semantics)`. Output kind: `["text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | Absolute path of the existing HDF5 file to read; it is captured and never modified. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | **required** |
| `sha256` | Optional expected SHA-256 of the source; a mismatch refuses the run. | `{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}` | omitted |
| `reference` | Absolute path of the file the source is compared against. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | **required** |
| `referenceSha256` | Optional expected SHA-256 of the reference file. | `{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}` | omitted |
| `dependencies` | Other files the result uses or reads, captured and published with it. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":40,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"role":{"type":"enum","values":["virtualSource","externalLink","rawStorage","copySource","reference"],"required":true},"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64}}},"maxItems":64}` | `[]` |
| `tolerance` | Comparison tolerances and scope. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"absolute":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"default":0},"relative":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"default":0},"paths":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":1024},"maxItems":256},"attributes":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"storage":{"type":"boolean","default":false}}}` | omitted |
| `access` | Optional access tuning for this run (chunk cache, alignment, metadata block, page buffer, extraction memory budget). | `{"type":"object","properties":{"chunkCache":{"type":"object","properties":{"bytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":1073741824,"required":true},"slots":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":16777213,"default":12421},"preemption":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1,"default":0.75}}},"pageBufferBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":512,"maximum":1073741824},"metaBlockBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":512,"maximum":16777216},"alignment":{"type":"object","properties":{"threshold":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2147483648,"default":1},"interval":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":16777216,"required":true}}},"memoryBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":4096,"maximum":1073741824},"sieveBufferBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":512,"maximum":268435456}}}` | omitted |
